በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ዘርአ: ዘርእ — seed (construct 'seed of') · also 'seed' as sown grain, absolute (ዘርአ ወማእረረ 'seed(time) and harvest') · accusative 'offspring' (ይሁበኒ እግዚኣብሔር ዘርአ 'may God give me offspring') · in apposition to ውሉድ: 'offspring' (አልቦውሉደ ዘርአ 'no child, no seed')
ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
ወለደ: ወለደ — he begot, bore (3ms perfect, G)
ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
ወሞተ: ሞተ — and he died (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-t)
ወፈነዎ: ፈነወ — and he sent him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, f-n-w + -ኦ 'him')
ኀቤሃ: ኀበ — to her, toward her (preposition ኀበ + -ሃ '3fs') · 'with, beside' (እንተ ኀቤሃ 'who were with her', ch. 55)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
እኁሁ: አኅ — brother (noun, base እኁ- before suffixes; + -ሁ 'his', 3ms)
ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ዚአሃ: ዚአ — hers, of her (possessive ዚአ + -ሃ '3fs her')
በስመ: ስም — by the name of (በ- 'by, in' + construct 'name of')
ወርእዮ: ርእየ — and he saw him (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -o, r-ʾ-y) · and seeing, and when he saw (ወ- + infinitive ርእዮ, circumstantial, with accusative object ዘንተ 'this')
ሜጠ: ሜጠ — he turned (3ms perfect, G; root m-y-ṭ)
እምኔሁ: እም — from (preposition + -ሁ 'him, it', 3ms, form እምኔ-) · 'than it', in comparison (ልብሰ ዘይኄይስ እምኔሁ 'a garment better than it')
ወአእተዋ: አእተወ — and he brought her in (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative + -ኣ '3fs her') (?)
ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
ለዛቲ: ዛቲ — to this, of this (ለ- + fem. demonstrative ዛቲ before ትውልድ)
ባዕድ: ባዕድ — another, a stranger (adjective/noun; ብእሲተ ባዕድ 'another man's wife') · 'strange, foreign' (አማልክተ ባዕድ 'strange gods')
ለእመ: እመ — if (conditional conjunction, ለእመ) · 'whether', introducing an indirect question (ለእመ ብኪ ትትባረክ 'whether through you she will be blessed') (?) · ለ- + እም 'mother' in construct: 'to the mother of' (ለእመ ዝንቱ ወሬዛ 'to the mother of this lad')
እሁቦ: ወሀበ — I will give him (1cs imperfect + -ኦ 'him')
ኪያሃ: ኪያሃ — her (accusative independent pronoun, 3fs; object of ያኀድጉነ)
ትነብር: ነበረ — she dwells, sits (3fs imperfect, n-b-r)
መጽአ: መጽአ — he/it came (3ms perfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
እምላዕሌሃ: ላዕል — from upon her (እም- + ላዕሌ- 'upon' + -ሃ '3fs her')
በአልባሰ: ልብስ — in garments of (በ- + plural አልባስ, construct 'garments of')
በአምሳለ: አምሳል — in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct አምሳለ)
ወሖረት: ሖረ — and she went (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
ወነበረት: ነበረ — and she sat, dwelt (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
ወለአከ: ለአከ — and he sent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
እፈቅድ: ፈቀደ — I desire, wish (1cs imperfect, G)
ወትቤሎ: ይቤ — and she said to him (ወ- + 3fs ትቤ of defective ይቤ + -ሎ '3ms to him')
ምንተ: ምንት — what? (interrogative pronoun, accusative) · exclamatory 'how' (ምንተ ሠነየኒ ቃልከ 'how pleasing to me is your word')
ወይቤላ: ይቤ — and he said to her (ወ- + 3ms perfect of defective ይቤ + -ላ '3fs to her')
እፌኑ: ፈነወ — I will send (1s imperfect, f-n-w)
ነግሀ: ነግህ — dawn (noun, accusative ነግሀ, used adverbially 'at dawn') (?); also 3ms perfect ነግሀ 'it dawned'
ማሕስአ: ማሕስአ — unknown word, apparently a young animal of the flock; meaning from context (?)
እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
ጠሊተ: ጠሊ — young animal, lamb or kid (?) (noun, accusative; the ending -ተ unexplained) (?)
ወወሀባ: ወሀበ — and he gave her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
በትረ: በትር — rod, staff (construct 'rod of') · also accusative 'rod(s)' after a number (ሠለስተ በትረ 'three rods')
ወሕልቀተ: ሕልቀት — and a ring (ወ- + noun, fem., accusative)
ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ወፈነወ: ፈነወ — and he sent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, f-n-w)
ላቲ: ለ — for her (preposition ለ- with 3fs suffix ላቲ) · 'to her' (ይሰግዱ ላቲ 'they bow to her', ch. 55) · ለ — after ያፈቅር, 'he loves her, is fond of her' (ያፈቅር ላቲ; ለ- marking the object, with -ቲ '3fs')
ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
ወይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — and they said to them (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎሙ 'to them')
አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
ወገብኡ: ገብአ — and they returned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
ወነገርዎ: ነገረ — and they told him (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, G + -ዎ 3ms object)
ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
ወነሥአ: ነሥአ — and he took (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
መላህቅተ: መልህቅ — anchor (plural መላህቅት; construct መላህቅተ, subject here); here figuratively 'stays, elders', the sense taken from context, 'elders of' (?) · or construct plural of ልሂቅ 'elder', 'elders of'
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
ወበትረ: በትር — and rod of (ወ- + noun, construct)
ወወሀበት: ወሀበ — and she gave (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-h-b)
ወትቤሎሙ: ይቤ — and she said to them (ወ- + 3fs perfect ትቤ of the irregular verb 'say' + ሎሙ 'to them')
ባዕለ: ባዕል — owner, lord (noun; construct 'owner of') · accusative predicate 'rich' (ወኮነ ባዕለ ጥቀ 'he became exceedingly rich'; 'powerful' is also possible (?))
በአእባን: እብን — with stones (በ- + noun, plural አእባን)
ንዋዮ: ንዋይ — his goods, property (noun, accusative + -ሁ '3ms his', ንዋዮ)
አእመረ: አእመረ — know, come to know (3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, not a true causative)
እምኔየ: እም — than me (እም- + -ኔየ '1s me') · 'from me' (ትርሐቅ እምኔየ 'that you go far from me')
ወኀደጋ: ኀደገ — and he let her, left her (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኣ '3fs her')
ክልኤተ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the form ክልኤተ before ስብረተ)
ሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — people (noun; predicate accusative) · people of (construct, ሕዝበ እግዚኣብሔር 'people of God', ሕዝበ እስራኤል 'people of Israel')
ወነግሠ: ነግሠ — and he reigned (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
ወዘርኡ: ዘርእ — and his seed (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his', ዘርኡ)
ተዐውቀ: ዐወቀ — it was/has become known (3ms perfect, tä-stem passive of ዐወቀ 'know' (?); rendered as a present 'it is known')
